bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than A4 size are not permitted. Permitted belongings are screened at entry, and event organizers may impose additional restrictions.
allowed: Bags no larger than A4 size
Empty foldable water bottles or Tetra Paks up to 0.5 liters for concerts
Small personal cameras, subject to the event policy
prohibited: Power banks weighing more than 100 grams
bagPolicy.note: Concert and match rules can differ. Paid luggage storage is offered for many concerts outside the south entrances.

parking.note: Event parking generally uses car parks P1–P3 with digital license-plate recognition. Prices and opening times vary by event; public transportation is recommended because departure delays can be lengthy.

rideshare.note: Taxi and rideshare instructions vary by event. For major concerts, official visitor information may direct taxis to the South Bus Park and publish a separate Uber route; check the event page before travel.

concessions.note: Food and drink stands operate on the Esplanade and inside the stadium during concerts and matches. Selection varies by event, and purchases are cashless. Outside food and drink are not permitted.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The route from Fröttmaning station is step-free, and accessible parking is in P1. Event-specific accessibility and companion-ticket arrangements should be confirmed before purchase.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is controlled by the organizer and may vary between football matches and concerts. Confirm with event staff before leaving the secured area.

ticketPickup.title: Tickets & Event Support
ticketPickup.body: Ticket delivery and support are handled by the official seller named for the event. Review the mobile-ticket or collection instructions in your order before traveling to the stadium.

gates.title: Entrances & Doors
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Allianz Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
